services.name: Folk School Canning Class
services.desc: Location: Crowley Museum and Nature Center, 16405 Myakka Road, Sarasota, Fl 34240 Learning Center. Description of class: Fill your pantry with the comforting traditions of home canning in this beginner-friendly class centered on simple living and old-fashioned homemaking skills. You’ll learn the basics of safe canning methods, preserving jams and other homemade staples to nourish your family year-round. We will be preparing and canning a seasonal relish. From the gentle simmer of the kitchen to the satisfying pop of sealed jars this class offers a warm and encouraging space to slow down work with intention and rediscover the timeless joy of providing from your own hands. Fresh, locally
